verdict.rationale: The evidence documents resolving errors: Slack messages include resolve/reopen buttons, and unresolved errors are auto-resolved when a deployment is recorded. Nothing shows assigning an owner, ignoring, or snoozing, and nothing explicitly states that a resolved error reopens automatically when it recurs. missing for 10: assign-owner capability, ignore action, snooze action, documented automatic reopen on regression, independent or hands-on corroboration of triage workflows
